specification.objective: Resolve mobile UI issues #139-143 in Kanban/Backlog and Audit Trail without changing synchronization, filtering, pagination, event data, or desktop behavior.

requirements.statement: The Kanban/Backlog loading state never shows the obsolete Sincronizando badge; real save, error and retry feedback remains available.
Backlog displays only its own functional text-search field; Kanban retains its existing top-level task search and other views are unchanged.
Mobile Kanban sections and cards have consistent visible vertical separation without overlap or excessive gaps.

On mobile Audit Trail, events use a naturally readable, sufficiently tall page-scrolling area; filters, CSV export, applied-filter summary, event details and load-more remain reachable, with pagination behavior intact.
On mobile, audit loading skeleton card containers match loaded event card width and horizontal alignment without changing internal placeholder padding.
Desktop layout, themes, task search/filter behavior, synchronization behavior and audit data/pagination semantics remain unchanged.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Regression tests prove the loading badge is absent during initial and board loading while loading skeletons and non-loading feedback continue to render.
Backlog tests find exactly one visible task text-search input in the filters area and verify query filtering, clearing, and board/backlog switching.
Responsive widget tests at narrow widths verify visible gaps between project controls, search, board toolbar, and columns with no overflow; desktop spacing remains unchanged.

Mobile Audit Trail tests verify natural page scrolling through full event cards to the load-more action, and keep filters/export/details reachable without a cramped nested viewport; pagination and desktop tests pass.
Mobile geometry tests compare audit loading skeleton outer bounds to loaded event-card bounds and ensure no horizontal overflow.
Focused regression tests fail on the locked baseline for the reported behavior, then pass after the smallest fixes; all existing and POLIS gates pass.

invariants.statement: Task synchronization and mutation operations are not disabled or altered.
Audit filters, event details, export, loading/error states and server pagination remain intact.
Desktop and unrelated application views do not change.

forbidden_states.statement: Sincronizando badge rendered during Kanban or Backlog loading.
Duplicate top-level and Backlog task search fields rendered together.
Mobile Kanban sections touch, overlap, or introduce excessive whitespace.
Mobile audit cards are clipped in a short nested viewport or skeletons are narrower than loaded cards.

inputs.statement: Kanban/Backlog states at mobile and desktop breakpoints, including loading and search interactions.
Audit Trail loading and loaded events, filters and pagination at mobile and desktop breakpoints.

outputs.statement: Minimal UI corrections and focused widget regressions for issues #139-143.
Retained POLIS contract, Red proof, validation report and concise reproduction notes.

failure_semantics.statement: The baseline regression fails on the specified visual/behavior assertions; setup, compilation, or missing-dependency errors are not accepted as behavioral Red.
Any pagination, filtering, synchronization, desktop, or existing test regression blocks acceptance.
